orders.text:
AO No. 541 of 2012 
Hon. B.S.Verma, J.
(Stay Application No. 12149 of 2012) 
Heard Mr. B.K.Gupta, Advocate, learned 
counsel for the appellant-Insurance Company. 
Admit the appeal. 
Issue notice to the respondent. 
Summon the Lower Court Record. 
List this appeal after LCR is received and 
service upon the respondents is effected. 
Execution of the impugned award dated 7-9-
2012 passed by the Motor Accident Claims 
Tribunal/District Judge, Bageshwar (for short the 
Tribunal) in MACP No. 4 of 2012, Smt. Anandi Devi 
Vs. Kundan Singh and others, shall remain stayed, 
provided the appellant deposits the entire awarded 
amount after adjusting the statutory deposit made in 
this appeal before the learned Tribunal within a period 
of eight weeks from today. (Stay application is 
disposed of.) 
 (B.S.Verma, J.) 
RCP 07-11-2012.
